ابتدرن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَدَرْنَ (ibtadarna) /ib.ta.dar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# اُبْتُدِرْنَ (ubtudirna) /ub.tu.dir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# اِبْتَدِرْنَ (ibtadirna) /ib.ta.dir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
